about_the_game:
FG Kingdoms World Building Map Pack


The FG Kingdoms World Building Map Pack features images and art produced by our in-house artist, Joshua Watmough. They have been organized and optimized for use with Fantasy Grounds VTT and the image tools. This art pack consists of images that can be used to create typical fantasy locations and maps. This pack consists of different buildings, rocky areas, farmlands, and so on, to be collaged together to create custom and interesting places. This pack includes the following items:

Brushes include stone walls, roads, land borders, and more
Buildings and other points of interest
Fills include several ground textures, crops, rocks and more

Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Joshua Watmough

Requires: An active subscription or a one time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds license and any ruleset.

Screenshots may differ from what you see in-game based on the extension and ruleset you have loaded.
